name: Omaezaki Yuu
source:
Your upperclassman by one year, she attends the same school as you.
Her model-class looks have won her fans in every class but her own—is it her stilted speech that sets her aloof?
Deep down, she's a caring older-sister type who'd like nothing more than to spoil you.
"My, you incorrigible thing. Yes, come here, I'll pamper you."

[From [url=https://www.johren.games/games/download/sutadhisutedhi-en-zh/]Johren.games[/url]]

Hobby: Archery, Reading
Favorite Food: Grandmother's stew
Relationship Goals: I'll handle [i]everything[/i]. Hee hee.

In [url=https://vndb.org/v30793]Fandisc[/url]: Height: 167cm, B92-W57-H88cm, H cup

[spoiler] She makes an appearance in Study § Steady 2 in [url=https://vndb.org/c100706//]Yuno[/url]'s route as Reido's lover.
She is also a distant relative of the Mamanoues.[/spoiler]

[spoiler] It's revealed that [url=https://vndb.org/c119175]Shimizu Ren[/url], the protagonist of [url=https://vndb.org/v32624]Study Steady 2[/url], is her childhood friend.[/spoiler]
